quadrants.name: Enabling
quadrants.description: The shared foundations every stage relies on: data platforms, common data environments, standards, collaboration tools, AI and automation.

quadrants.name: Design
quadrants.description: How we create, analyse and coordinate designs: modelling and analysis tools, computational and generative design, clash detection and design for manufacture and assembly.

quadrants.name: Construction
quadrants.description: How we build on site and off site: construction methods, materials, site equipment, offsite and modular manufacture, and monitoring of progress, quality and safety.

quadrants.name: Commissioning & Handover
quadrants.description: Bringing assets into use and passing them to the client: testing and commissioning, asset information, digital handover, operations and maintenance data, and soft landings.

rings.name: Adopt
rings.description: We use this with confidence and recommend it as the default choice.

rings.name: Trial
rings.description: Worth pursuing on a project that can handle some risk. We have seen it work.

rings.name: Assess
rings.description: Worth exploring to understand how it could affect us. Not yet for production.

rings.name: Caution
rings.description: Proceed carefully. We advise against starting new work with this.
